== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[4-LOM With Concussion Rifle (V) (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]] (<code>1262_1</code>, Virtual Block 6.2 slip 2-01), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. The Virtual Block 6.2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB6-01-4_LOM_With_Concussion_Rifle.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-4lomwithconcussionrifle-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[4-LOM With Concussion Rifle (V) (Virtual Block 6)]]; the Master List (2013) prints the original too.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post p874174 by Lukes Bionic Hand, 27 March 2014: https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p874174. Icons the post writes out are drawn as the slips print them.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Permanent weapon is •4-LOM's Concussion Rifle (may target a character for free; target is power -1 until end of turn). Once per turn, may place a card from hand on bottom of Used Pile to draw top card from Reserve Deck.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 73) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1262_1</code>: Decipher art, frame, title, lore, icons, set mark, caption, copyright line) with the PC-E1 game text. Lore keywords set in bold and the icon order (Permanent Weapon, Warrior) as printed. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB6-01-4_LOM_With_Concussion_Rifle-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B38 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
